subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should OpenClaw adopt browser-local, per-Gateway/per-agent persistence for New Session workspace, worktree, model, and reasoning choices as a supported Control UI behavior?
rationale: This is a new user-facing persistence behavior rather than a repair to a documented existing contract, and the linked canonical issue carries an explicit product-decision signal.

options.title: Approve the browser-local preference scope
options.body: Accept the proposed per-browser persistence model once connected-Gateway restore and stale-fallback proof is added.

options.title: Narrow the remembered choices
options.body: Persist only the selections maintainers want to support long term and remove the remaining preference fields before merge.

options.title: Decline persistent New Session preferences
options.body: Keep the existing stateless draft behavior and close the implementation as an unapproved product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the browser-local preference scope
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed per-browser persistence model once connected-Gateway restore and stale-fallback proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history connects steipete most directly to the proposed UI behavior, though formal ownership should be confirmed by repository maintainers.
